description: For one ruling identifier (ACPREC-YYYY-NNNN): what was decided about an evidence conflict, why, on which records, its status now (settled, unresolved or superseded) and its RFC 3161 timestamp where one has been issued, together with a fresh lookup of the current governing record for the ruling's medicine, market and date where the ruling names one. A ruling is not evidence and decides no claim today; the current governing record does, and the ruling records only how the earlier conflict was decided. Where no current record is held, the answer names the competent authority and where its own record is published.

date.description: The date to resolve the current record for, YYYY-MM-DD. Defaults to today (UTC).

id.description: The ruling identifier, for example ACPREC-2026-0001.

name: lookup_precedent_ruling
title: A numbered AlphaCitation ruling on an evidence conflict
